name: Numeric Rating Scale
description: 0–10 numeric scale for patient self-report of pain intensity.
instructions: On a scale of 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain imaginable, how would you rate your pain right now?
shirleySays: ICC reliability: 0.96 (excellent). MDC: 2 points. MCID: 2 points (chronic pain, MSK, LBP). Validated across virtually all conditions; widely normed in adult, older adult, pediatric (≥8 yrs), cancer, post-surgical, and ICU populations. Strong correlation with VAS (r=0.94). Watch for integer bias and cognitive load in severe neurological impairment.

scoring.mcidNote: 2-point change is clinically meaningful for chronic pain and MSK conditions
